AsyncOperatorWorkerError::PrepareTimeout::timeout_ms: Stores the timeout value for `PrepareTimeout`, in milliseconds.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::PrepareTimeout: Reports that prepare exceeded its deadline.

pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::Timeout: Reports that the operation exceeded its deadline.

AsyncOperatorWorkerError::CloseTimeout::timeout_ms: Stores the timeout value for `CloseTimeout`, in milliseconds.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::CloseTimeout: Reports that close exceeded its deadline.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::Cancel: Classifies a failure at the cancel stage or component of `AsyncOperatorWorkerError`.
AsyncOperatorWorkerError::CancelTimeout::timeout_ms: Stores the timeout value for `CancelTimeout`, in milliseconds.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::CancelTimeout: Reports that cancel exceeded its deadline.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::MissingDerivedLineage: Reports that the required derived lineage is missing.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::DerivedLineageMismatch: Reports that derived lineage does not match the expected contract.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::OutputSignalMismatch: Reports that output signal does not match the expected contract.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::UndeclaredOutputRole: Reports that output role was emitted or requested without a declaration.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::MissingOutputContract: Reports that the required output contract is missing.
AsyncOperatorWorkerError::UnknownInputPort::port_name: Stores the human-readable port used to identify `UnknownInputPort`.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::UnknownInputPort: Reports that the referenced input port is not declared or registered.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::AmbiguousOutputPort: Reports that output port resolves to more than one candidate.
AsyncOperatorWorkerError::TerminalOutputDropped::branch_index: Identifies the branch index position within `TerminalOutputDropped`.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::TerminalOutputDropped: Reports that terminal output was dropped before delivery completed.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::OutputPayloadTooLarge: Reports that output payload exceeds the supported size limit.
AsyncOperatorWorkerError::OutputPayloadTooLarge::branch_index: Identifies the branch index position within `OutputPayloadTooLarge`.
AsyncOperatorWorkerError::OutputPayloadTooLarge::payload_bytes: Stores the payload size for `OutputPayloadTooLarge`, in bytes.
AsyncOperatorWorkerError::OutputPayloadTooLarge::max_payload_bytes: Limits payload storage for `OutputPayloadTooLarge`, in bytes.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::Join: Classifies a failure at the join stage or component of `AsyncOperatorWorkerError`.
AsyncOperatorWorkerError::InvalidPlanInput::kind: Records the kind selected for `InvalidPlanInput`.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::InvalidPlanInput: Reports that the supplied plan input is invalid.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::PlanInputLineageMismatch: Reports that plan input lineage does not match the expected contract.
pocketstation::runtime::signal::error::AsyncOperatorWorkerError::SharedAudioTypedInput: Classifies a failure at the shared audio typed input stage or component of `AsyncOperatorWorkerError`.
